about: The Workbench icons of the Wizznic drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own data/wmicon.png (art/wizznic.png, GPL 3 like the game's media). Wizznic-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Wizznic.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Wizznic.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-Wizznic, Media-Licences, Credits, Licences and COPYING; Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer (data, packs and theirs).
